en.topic_title: Taiwan accuses Hong Kong residents of hiring 4 people to spy on lawmaker critical of China
en.topic_summary:
Four people were charged after allegedly surveilling a Taiwanese lawmaker and his family two years ago, prosecutors said on Wednesday.



Lawmaker Puma Shen and the pinhole camera found on his motorbike. Photo: Puma Shen, via Facebook.



Taipei prosecutors alleged that two people in Hong Kong hired the four Taiwanese defendants to follow, film and photograph Puma Shen, who is a member of the ruling Democratic Progressive Party (DPP) and an outspoken critic of China.
